text: HDFC Bank Alert: OTP for Rs. 4,500 transaction at Amazon India is 829104. Valid for 10 mins. Do not share OTP with anyone, including bank staff.
label: non_scam
why_it_looks_suspicious: Contains high urgency time window (valid for 10 mins), transaction amounts, and 6-digit security token.
why_it_is_legitimate: Standard institutional 3D-secure OTP sent over registered transactional gateway with explicit anti-sharing cautionary advisory.
notes: Standard transactional OTP format across Indian scheduled commercial banks.

text: BESCOM Electricity Reminder: Your electricity bill for RR No. E182901 of Rs. 1,480 is due on 22-Oct. Pay securely via official portal https://bescom.karnataka.gov.in
label: non_scam
why_it_looks_suspicious: Mentions electricity bill payment due dates and monetary requests.
why_it_is_legitimate: Directs user strictly to verified .gov.in state government domain without threats of immediate disconnection.

text: Amazon Delivery Update: Your package with order #402-9182736 is out for delivery with delivery agent Ramesh. Share delivery PIN 4910 at the doorstep upon handover.

why_it_is_legitimate: Standard secure handover PIN requested strictly at physical doorstep; does not request online payment or link clicks.
